top_candidates.original_title: Tell HN: Litellm 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI are compromised
top_candidates.generated_headline: PyPI Supply Chain Hit: Litellm Releases 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 Found Compromised
top_candidates.summary: Two versions of the popular LLM proxy library *litellm*—1.82.7 and 1.82.8—were pulled from PyPI after users reported suspicious behavior, including unauthorized network callbacks.
